main_body: Grey-steel mine cart body with a light rim, a dark interior/front panel, two wheels and a few gold ore bits on top
top_band: light grey rim at rows 4-5 (L=170 then L=126), about 2 rows; below it only dark grey face tones (L=82, 61)
evidence: The column at x=8 reads: rows 1-3 ore/outline, row 4 light rim (L=170), row 5 mid (L=126), then rows 6-11 dark grey body (L=82/61/82). The only light surface is a 1-2 row rim, which is too thin to read as a top surface. The dark area below is a flat front face with wheels, not an ellipse showing the inside of the cart. The gold ore dots sit on or above the rim, so no contents surface is seen from above. This is a rim-only front elevation, not a container with a visible opening.

style.evidence: The candidate has 9 distinct colours in total against 38-40 for the references, and a median of 9 colours per tile against 17-20. 92% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line, unlike the tinted outlines of the references. It has about 5 grey steps, but they are cool, almost monochrome, and have little grain or per-material texture. The hue is not judged, but the structure is thinner and flatter than the Beodeul props.
